title: Adopting Duke as a father figure and declining to go on the road
summary: Jones's father mailed him Ellington clippings at school; later he told Duke it was too late to join the band.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Well, you know, that can happen. Because I just adopted Duke as a father when I was a kid, and my father got crazy about the music so much he would always keep me posted where Duke was playing, or you know, when I was away in school, and what he did, he would send me the clippings and the publicity.
I saw a reference to that in (inaudible) book.
Yeah. And so my parents, you know, they just said, 'Well, James has got somebody to look up to,' in case anything would happen to them, you know?

And I would have something to lean on. And it worked. It worked out that way. Only up to the point where Duke wanted me to go on the road. And I told him, I said, 'Edward it's too late now. I think if we had both started this when I was much, much younger, and something to build on.' You know.
It would have been at a better time in both of our lives to make it. But he still -- he still liked my work. He still called on me for -- you know?
